name: D.O.T.S. Projector
facts: Creates a field of green lights when placed. Used to detect D.O.T.S Projector evidence.

name: EMF Reader
facts: Can detect EMF presence in the area. Used to obtain EMF Level 5 evidence.

name: Flashlight
facts: Provides a basic source of light.

name: Ghost Writing Book
facts: Used to obtain Ghost Writing from a ghost.

name: Spirit Box
facts: Used to communicate with a ghost through questions.

name: Thermometer
facts: Displays the local temperature of a room. Can be used to detect Freezing Temperatures.

name: UV Light
facts: Used to reveal fingerprints and footprints created by ghosts.

name: Video Camera
facts: Creates a video feed, which is relayed to the truck's computer. Used to detect Ghost Orbs, as well as to make recordings for additional rewards.

name: Crucifix
facts: Prevents ghosts from hunting in a certain radius.

name: Firelight
facts: Used for optional objectives, and to provide light.

name: Head Gear
facts: Can be equipped on a player's head. Actual functionality depends on upgrade tier. •  Tier 1 is a camera which provides a video feed to the computer (which teammates can use to detect Ghost Orbs). •  Tier 2 is an LED flashlight, providing weak illumination without requiring another inventory slot. •  Tier 3 is a set of night-vision goggles, making surroundings easier to see at the cost of moderate visual distortion.

name: Igniter
facts: Used to light firelights and incense. Can also be used on campfires in Maple Lodge Campsite and Camp Woodwind.

name: Incense
facts: Used to prevent a ghost from hunting for a short period of time. Can also be used during a hunt to blind the ghost temporarily.

name: Motion Sensor
facts: Goes off when a ghost or player passes it, flashing a small light. A signal is also provided to the Truck.

name: Parabolic Microphone
facts: Used to listen to paranormal sounds in a large range.

name: Photo Camera
facts: Used to take photos of various items for additional rewards.

name: Salt
facts: Places salt piles that ghosts can interact with to leave footprints.

name: Sanity Medication
facts: Restores the consumer's sanity by a certain amount dependent on Difficulty.

name: Sound Recorder
facts: Used to make recordings of various paranormal sounds for additional rewards.

name: Sound Sensor
facts: Detects sounds in an area, and relays the data to the Truck.

name: Tripod
facts: Used as a mount for Video Cameras. Lowers the chance for ghost to throw a Video Camera.
